annotations.title: Compute and compare a file checksum

description: Computes the SHA-256 or SHA-512 digest of a local file (regular file, up to 32 MiB) and optionally compares it with an expected value. A match proves only that the file equals whatever the expected value was taken from, so it is only as trustworthy as the source of that value.

expected.description: Optional expected digest (hex; "sha256:<hex>" and sha256sum-style "<hex>  name" are accepted) to compare against.

path.description: Path of the file to hash (regular file, up to 32 MiB).

name: file_checksum
title: Compute and compare a file checksum
